contingent upon resurgence of the virus
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides balanced discussion of strong 2020 performance alongside pandemic-related uncertainty and expected future credit deterioration. Key risks include delayed loan losses after stimulus exhaustion, economic volatility, vaccine and reopening uncertainty, and potential weaknesses in selected industries, although management presents these risks within a generally resilient and confident operating narrative.
